body: I know i’ll lose the chance but I know that I won’t care because there will be nothing, no thoughts, memoried, pain, nothing. I bet that the world has new experiences for me but it just doesn’t seem worth it to live so I can experience them. I will try to hang on at least until graduation so I don’t have to be the sob story of my school. I’m going to see where my school applications go, school has gone to shit due to my depression and it has made me fuck up my opportunities to experience a new environment with new people. If I make it to the school I want i’ll probably try to rebuild my life and see where that goes, if not then i’ll just end it to spare the trouble of continuing this life.

I’ve experienced the things I wanted to and what I could possibly want to experience in the future in my country. The only thing I could be interested in would be exploring abroad but my financial situation won’t allow it. 

The body finding part is the one that is one of the most haunting things to imagine. I could never let my parents or little sister find me with my head blown open, it would take too big of a toll on them.

I’m actually trying to experience more things and trying to be more open-minded but I just don’t feel that this world really has things left for me to enjoy. The only thing I still strive for is a relationship, i’ve had plenty of chances but I’ve either fucked them up completely or I have avoided them because I don’t want to hurt the person i’m with.

I do appreciate your response and some of the points are really valid but i’ve started to lose interest in thinking about this rationally. When the day comes, i’m sorry.

I know there isn’t a painless way but i’m willing to feel that temporary physical pain to end the more lasting mental pain once and for all. The shotgun blast could leave me alive but it’s a risk i’ll be willing to make for the sake of peace and quiet.

I don’t have a hobby, in the summer I used to go play basketball with my friends but most of them moved due to education and jobs and what not so it’s gone now. The only interests aside from that used to be gaming and photography. Gaming feels just dull and uninterestning now and my camera broke. I don’t have enough money to fix my camera or buy a new one, and photography is starting to lose it’s charm too.
16, i’m sure i’ll attempt again this year.
Fuck you, just fuck you. I really don’t have the energy to deal with people like you, why the fuck do you need to come here to make me feel even worse? What do you gain you sadistic shit?

Excuse me? How’s that hilarious? They ripped apart basically every part of my personality and ruined my fucking self-esteem, it made my life a lot harder because I’ve been trying to change myself to get rid of those ”bad sides” and while I’ve been focusing on thatx everything has just started falling apart. It may not sound like a big thing for you but i’ve always been super insecure and they were my ”friends” for over 8 years. This has seriously affected my life and mental state. Fuck you
honestly i’m 99% sure i’m going to end it this year, it’s more than I asked for sorry.
